hints.en: Inside the job: `needs: build` and `environment: staging`.

hints.tr: Adımlar: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/download-artifact@v4` (`name: dist`, `path: dist`), sonra dağıtım komutu.
hints.en: Steps: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/download-artifact@v4` (`name: dist`, `path: dist`), then the deploy command.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install build
      - run: python -m build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
  deploy-staging:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - run: python scripts/deploy.py staging
```
